entries.source:
The pounding forge of thought in your mind is released upon your surroundings.  Each turn that you remain stationary, you'll strike the dreamforge, inflicting mind and burning damage on enemies around you.
		The effect will build over five turns, until it reaches a maximum radius of %d, maximum mind damage of %0.2f, and maximum burning damage of %0.2f.
		At this point you'll begin breaking the dreams of enemies who hear the forge, reducing their Mental Save by %d and giving them a %d%% chance of spell failure due to the tremendous echo in their minds for %d turns.
		Broken Dreams has a %d%% chance to brainlock your enemies.
		The damage and dream breaking effect will scale with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
你脑海中轰鸣的思想熔炉向四周释放。你每原地不动一回合，就会锤击一次梦之熔炉，对周围的敌人造成精神和燃烧伤害。
		该效果会在 5 回合内逐步增强，最终范围达到 %d 格，精神伤害和燃烧伤害分别达到 %0.2f 和 %0.2f 点。
		此后，你会开始打破听到熔炉声的敌人的梦境：由于熔炉的巨大回响，它们的精神豁免降低 %d， 并获得 %d%% 的法术失败率，持续 %d 回合。
		梦境破碎有 %d%% 几率使敌人陷入思维封锁。
		伤害和梦境打破效果受精神强度加成。

entries.source:
Overcharge your psionic focus with energy for %d turns, producing a different effect depending on what it is.
		A telekinetically wielded melee weapon enters a frenzy, striking up to %d enemies per turn, also increases the radius by %d.
		A mindstar will attempt to pull in all enemies within its normal range.
		A gem will fire an energy bolt at a random enemy in range 6, each turn for %0.1f damage. The type is determined by the colour of the gem. Damage scales with Mindpower.
entries.target:
向你的灵能聚焦物注入过量能量，持续 %d 回合，视其种类产生不同效果。
		念动近战武器进入狂乱，每回合最多攻击 %d 个敌人，攻击半径变为 %d 格。
		灵晶会尝试将其正常范围内的所有敌人拉到身边。
		宝石每回合向 6 格内最近的敌人发射能量球，造成 %0.1f 伤害。伤害类型取决于宝石的颜色，伤害随精神强度提高。

entries.source: Any time you block an attack with Buckler Expertise or Buckler Mastery you instantly counterattack with your sling for %d%% damage  This can only occur up to %d time(s) per turn.
entries.target: 每当你的盾牌训练或格挡大师技能挡住攻击时，你立刻使用投石索发动一次伤害 %d%% 的反击。每回合最多可发动 %d + 1 次反击。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Combat stat#WHITE# scores are between one and one-hundred, with special color coding applied for each interval of twenty. The colors are the same hues as those used in inventory text to indicate gear quality.

These subintervals of twenty we'll call #GOLD#tiers#WHITE# from now on.
entries.target:
#GOLD#战斗属性#WHITE# 范围为1～100，每隔20会用一种不同颜色来显示，在装备提示文字中也用类似的色调来表示装备的品质。

从现在起，我们把这些 20 点的区间称为#GOLD#层级#WHITE#。

entries.source:
Ogres are magically-altered Humans, taking refuge in Elvala among the Shalore. 
Their enormous bodies, bolstered by (and dependent on) an intricate web of glowing runes covering their skin, make them an intimidating sight that belies their conscientious and modest nature.
Ogres were created (and subsequently abandoned) by the Conclave during the Allure Wars, to serve as their warriors and workers.  Their massive size and glowing runes made it impossible for them to hide during the Spellhunt, and only those who fled to Shalore lands survived extermination.
Their talent with inscriptions is unparalleled, as they need to be able to maintain their own inscriptions to survive, and have passed down the knowledge of how to do so; while their tendency to solve problems in the most simple and direct manner available (combined with an...  intense temper) has given them an unfair reputation as unintelligent brutes, a growing trade industry in inscription production is gradually eroding this image.

You have learned the details of the Ogres' past and put their terrified creators to rest, and have technically brought the Allure Wars to their long-overdue conclusion by eliminating the last remnants of the Conclave.  You can now create new #LIGHT_GREEN#Ogre#WHITE# characters to see their magical might in action!

Race features:#YELLOW#
- Strong but not stupid
- Efficient at using all kind of runes and infusions
- Imbued with arcane forces
#WHITE#
entries.target:
食人魔是被魔法改变的人类，在埃尔瓦拉与永恒精灵为伴避难。
他们庞大的身躯由覆盖皮肤的复杂发光符文网络强化（也依赖于这套符文网络），外表令人生畏，却掩盖了他们认真而谦逊的天性。
在厄流战争中，孔克雷夫创造了食人魔作为工人和战士，但最后他们成为了被遗弃的种族。他们庞大的体型和身上闪光的符文让他们在魔法狩猎期间无处藏身，只有那些逃去永恒精灵领地的少量族群幸免于难。
由于他们必须维护自己身上的刻印才能存活，他们运用刻印的能力无可比拟，这份知识也代代相传。他们解决问题的时候习惯使用最简单直接的手段，再加上他们……暴躁的脾性，这一切让他们获得了“愚蠢粗暴的野蛮人”这一不公的名声。然而，日益发展的刻印制作贸易正逐渐消除这种印象。

你了解了食人魔过往的详情，并让他们那惊恐万分的创造者得以安息。你消灭了孔克雷夫最后的残余，从名义上为这场早该结束的厄流战争画上了句号。现在，你可以创造新的#LIGHT_GREEN#食人魔#WHITE#角色，在实战中发挥他们的魔法力量吧！

种族特色：#YELLOW#
- 强壮但不愚笨
- 善于使用各种纹身和符文
- 灌注奥术的力量
#WHITE#

entries.source:
In Maj'Eyal threats are everywhere when you walk the wildlands, some rogues prefer to forgo the use of stealth instead using their cunning skills to kill silently from afar with a sling well protected with a buckler.

You have learned the power of counterstriking from afar and can now create characters with the #LIGHT_GREEN#Skirmisher class#WHITE#.

Skirmishers are highly mobile rogues that specialize in running and gunning, using Slings to harass, debilitate, and wear down enemies before finishing them off with extremely quick attacks.

Class features:#YELLOW#
- Vault and roll around your foes, staying one step ahead and just out of
reach
- Cripple your opponents and unleash a torrent of sling bullets
- Block enemy fire with your buckler mastery and counter attack#WHITE#

Skirmisher use stamina to fuel their techniques, which replenishes slowly over time.
entries.target:
当你漫步在马基·埃亚尔大陆上广袤的荒野之地时，你会发现威胁无处不在。一些盗贼放弃了传统的潜行手段，转而凭借诡诈的技能，在盾牌的保护下用投石索从远处悄然击杀对手。

你已经掌握了从远处发动反击的力量，现在创建人物时可以选择#LIGHT_GREEN#散兵#WHITE#职业。

散兵是高度机动的盗贼，运用游击战术的好手，利用手中的投石索袭扰、削弱并消耗敌人，再以极快的攻击将其终结。

职业特点：#YELLOW#
- 跃过并翻滚绕开敌人，始终领先一步，保持在攻击
范围之外
- 致残对手，并射出一阵投石索弹幕
- 凭借盾牌专精挡住敌人的远程攻击并反击#WHITE#

散兵使用体力值来施放他们的技能，体力值会随时间缓慢恢复。

entries.source:
While most races of Eyal firmly believe that arcane and nature forces are opposites, Dwarves have found a way to bind them together and meld them into a power to be reckoned with.

You have mastered some arcane and wild talents at a crude level can now create new dwarf characters with the #LIGHT_GREEN#Stone Warden class#WHITE#.

Stone Wardens are Wilders, who are at home in the wilds and draw their power from their connection with nature and arcane
Class features:#YELLOW#
- Dual wield shields and bash your foes with arcane enhanced shield strikes
- Combine arcane and nature forces to split yourself into two powerful halves
- Use vines of stone to grab and assail your foes
- Turn into a huge earth elemental and summon volcanos
- Dwarf race exclusive class (Select it at birth for the option to even appear)#WHITE#

All Wilder classes use Equilibrium for their powers. It represents their connection to nature. 
The higher it gets the more off-balance they are with it. A high Equilibrium makes for a chance to fail to use a power and lose a turn.
Stone Wardens also use Mana.
entries.target:
尽管大部分埃亚尔的种族都坚信奥术和自然的力量势不两立，矮人们找到了一种方法，可以将它们联结起来，组成一种让人无法忽视的强大力量。

你已经初步掌握了一些奥术与自然技能，现在创建的新矮人角色可以选择#LIGHT_GREEN#岩石守卫职业#WHITE#。

岩石守卫是野性系职业，他们植根于自然，从自然和奥术的联结中汲取力量。
职业特性：#YELLOW#
- 双持盾牌，用奥术强化的盾击攻击敌人
- 结合奥术和自然的力量，产生两个强大的分身。
- 使用岩石藤蔓抓取并攻击敌人。
- 变化成巨大的岩石元素，召唤火山。
- 这是矮人专属的职业，只有在创建角色画面选择矮人才能看到。#WHITE#

所有野性系职业使用自然失衡值作为其能量，它代表着他们与自然之间的联系。
失衡值越高，他们与自然越不平衡。失衡值过高可能导致能力使用失败并损失一个回合。
岩石守卫同样使用法力值。

entries.source:
In the wilds, some people and creatures are able, by the sole force of their will, to call upon allies to help them in combat.
You have witnessed such an act and can now create new characters with the #LIGHT_GREEN#Summoner class#WHITE#.

Summoners are Wilders, who are at home in the wilds and draw their power from their connection with nature.
Class features:#YELLOW#
- Summon allies, ranging from a war hound to the mighty fire drake
- Take direct control of your summons
- Augment your summons with various powers#WHITE#

All Wilder classes use Equilibrium for their powers. It represents their connection to nature. 
The higher it gets the more off-balance they are with it. A high Equilibrium makes for a chance to fail to use a power and lose a turn.
entries.target:
在野外，有些人和生物仅凭意志力，就能召唤盟友协助战斗。
你已经见证了这种力量的存在，现在你可以在创建人物时选择新的职业：#LIGHT_GREEN#召唤师#WHITE#。

召唤师属于野性系，以野外为家，与自然的联系是他们的力量来源。
职业特点：#YELLOW#
- 能召唤盟友，从战争猎犬到强大的火龙不等
- 能直接控制你的召唤物
- 使用不同的方式强化你的召唤物#WHITE#

所有野性系职业使用自然失衡值作为其能量，它代表着他们与自然之间的联系。
失衡值越高，他们与自然越不平衡。失衡值过高可能导致能力使用失败并损失一个回合。

entries.source:
Yeeks are a mysterious race of small humanoids native to the tropical island of Rel.
Their body is covered with white fur and their disproportionate heads give them a ridiculous look, yet they are a cunning and willful race.
Although they are now nearly unheard of in Maj'Eyal, they spent many centuries as secret slaves to the Halfling nation of Nargol.
They gained their freedom during the Age of Pyre and have since then followed 'The Way' - a unity of minds enforced by their powerful psionics.

You have helped a Yeek Wayist and can now create a new character with the #LIGHT_GREEN#Yeek race#WHITE#.

Race features:#YELLOW#
- Mental domination racial power
- Confusion resistance
- Fast leveling
- Frail body#WHITE#
entries.target:
夺心魔是热带瑞尔岛上的原住民，一个神秘的小型人形种族。
他们的身体长着白色的毛发，另外，不成比例的巨大脑袋使他们看上去有点滑稽。不过他们是非常灵巧而且意志强大的种族。
尽管在马基·埃亚尔几乎没有听说过他们，但在烈火纪之前的漫长岁月里，他们曾是半身人国家纳格尔的秘密奴隶。
他们在烈火纪获得了自由，并从此遵循“维网”——一种由他们强大的灵能维系的心灵统一。

你帮助了一名夺心魔维网信徒，现在你可以在创建人物时选择新的种族：#LIGHT_GREEN#夺心魔#WHITE#。

种族特点：#YELLOW#
- 拥有精神控制的种族能力
- 混乱抗性
- 升级较快
- 脆弱的身躯#WHITE#

entries.source: It looks like a very tiny star -- deep black -- and yet it somehow shines.
entries.target: 它看起来像是一颗非常小巧的星星——深邃而黑暗——却不知为何闪着光芒。

entries.source: Rod of Spydric Poison
entries.target: 蜘蛛之毒杖

entries.source: A young girl with skin pale as snow. She is small, but deadly in battle, unleashing a constant barrage of ice shards.
entries.target: 一位有着雪白肌肤的年轻女孩。她身材娇小，在战斗中却极为致命，会接连不断地射出冰箭。

entries.source: Ranged fighters coming to the arena looking for wealth and glory, just like you.
entries.target: 前来竞技场寻求财富和荣誉的远程斗士，就像你一样。

entries.target: 炼金术士

entries.target: 闪光弹的粗皮投石索

entries.target: #GOLD#小Boss轮开始！！

entries.target: #VIOLET#Boss轮开始！！！

entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#最终轮开始！！！！

entries.target: 级别提升！！

entries.target: %d击杀！

entries.source: A Halfling slinger. He seems adept at combat.
entries.target: 一位半身人投石者，他似乎很擅长战斗。

entries.source: Fyrk, Faeros High Guard
entries.target: 法罗高阶守卫弗莱克

entries.source:
Faeros are highly intelligent fire elementals, rarely seen outside volcanoes. They are probably not native to this world.
This one looks even nastier and looks toward you with what seems to be disdain. Flames swirl all around him.
entries.target:
法罗是高智慧的火焰元素，在火山以外的其他地方很少看到。它们很可能不属于这个世界。
这只看起来更加凶残，它用蔑视的眼神看着你。火焰在它的身上流转。

entries.source: Old Conclave Vault
entries.target: 古老的孔克雷夫宝库

entries.source: A female Human with twisted sigils scored into her naked flesh. Her wrists and ankles are sore and hurt by ropes and chains. You can discern great beauty beyond the stains of blood covering her skin.
entries.target: 一位人类女子，赤裸的肌肤上刻满了扭曲的符文。她的手腕和脚踝被绳索与锁链勒得伤痕累累。透过皮肤上斑斑的血迹，你仍能看出她的绝美容颜。

entries.source:
The woman seems to be freed from her bonds.
She stumbles on her feet, her naked body still dripping in blood. 'Please get me out of here!'
entries.target:
这个女人似乎已摆脱了束缚。
她踉跄着站立不稳，赤裸的身体仍在滴血。“请带我离开这里！”

entries.source: The rift leads... somewhere.
entries.target: 这道裂隙通向……某个地方。

entries.source: Claws and teeth. Ice and death. Dragons are not all extinct it seems...
entries.target: 利爪与尖牙，寒冰与死亡。似乎龙族并没有完全灭绝……

entries.source: Claws and teeth. Fire and death. Dragons are not all extinct it seems...
entries.target: 利爪与尖牙，烈焰与死亡。似乎龙族并没有完全灭绝……

entries.source: slimy crawler
entries.target: 黏糊糊的爬虫

entries.source: A horrid mass of pustulent flesh, sinew, and bone; this creature seems to constantly be in pain. Two heads glare malevolently at you, an intruder in its domain.
entries.target: 一团由化脓的血肉、肌腱和骨头组成的恐怖混合体，这只生物似乎无时无刻不在承受痛苦。它的两个脑袋恶狠狠地瞪着你这个闯入其领地的不速之客。

entries.source: Those leather boots can make anybody as annoying as their former possessor, Draebor.
entries.target: 这双皮靴能让任何人都变得像它的前任主人小恶魔德瑞宝一样惹人厌烦。

entries.source: A malevolent skeleton archmage that has taken control of the Dreadfell since the Master's demise.
entries.target: 一位邪恶的骷髅大法师，自领主死后便掌控了恐惧王座。

entries.source: Borfast the Broken
entries.target: 残破的波法斯特

entries.source:
What once must have been an enchantingly beautiful Higher woman now looks to be a ghost of utter despair. Her thin, elegant form ripples gently in the air, whilst her tattered robes seem oddly still. The ghost's face looks jittery and pained whilst her wild, glowing eyes move rapidly back and forth in their sockets.
Now and then she seems to see something and her jaw pulls back, her whole face splitting apart as she shrieks an unholy cry of pain and torment.
entries.target:
这位曾经想必美得摄人心魄的高等人类女子，如今看上去只是一只彻底绝望的幽灵。她瘦弱而优雅的身躯在空中轻轻荡漾，破烂的长袍却诡异地纹丝不动。她的脸上满是抽搐与痛苦，狂乱而发亮的眼睛在眼眶里飞快地来回转动。
她不时像是看到了什么，下颌随之向后扯开，整张脸仿佛裂成两半，发出一声充满痛苦与折磨的邪异尖啸。

entries.source: A letter written in a bold, commanding script
entries.target: 一封字迹遒劲、透着威严的信

entries.source: Your wife has been turned into a giant, bloated form that towers above you. Mucus and slime ooze from every orifice, dripping onto the floor. The sight and the smell make you retch.
entries.target: 你的妻子变成了一只铁塔般的浮肿怪物。黏液和粘稠的液体从每个孔洞向外渗出，不断滴落在地板上。眼前的景象和扑鼻的气味使你异常反胃。

entries.source:
A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They usually require an external item to use. You have no idea if it is even two-way.
This one seems to go to the west, to Charred Scar. A fiery volcano that can only spell death...
entries.target:
远行传送门能让人眨眼间跨越难以想象的距离。它们通常需要借助外部物品才能使用。你不知道这道门是否为双向的。
这道门似乎通向西方，通向灼烧之痕——一座烈焰翻腾的火山，去了只有死路一条……

entries.source:
This giant golem was constructed by the Halflings during the Pyre Wars to fight the orcs, but was felled by Garkul the Devourer.
Its body is made of marble, its joints of solid voratun, and its sole eye of purest ruby; the other one seems to be missing. At over 40 feet tall, it towers above you.
Someone foolish has tried to reconstruct it, but was unable to complete the task; the golem needs another eye to be complete.
entries.target:
这尊巨型傀儡是由半身人在烈火战争中为对抗兽人制造的，但它却被吞噬者加库尔所摧毁。
它的身躯由大理石制成，关节由坚固的沃瑞钽打造，仅有的一只眼睛由纯净的红宝石构成，另一只眼睛似乎已经遗失。它高达四十多英尺，巍然耸立在你面前。
某个蠢货曾试图重建它，却没能完成；这尊傀儡还需要另一只眼睛才能完整。

entries.source: #VIOLET#You hear a rock crumbling opening.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你听到了岩石崩裂、通路打开的声音。

entries.source: The Legend of Garkul the Devourer, mightiest of all orcs.
entries.target: 吞噬者加库尔——所有兽人中最强大者——的传说。

entries.source: Subject Z
entries.target: 实验体 Z

entries.source: This seems to be the 'subject Z' the notes spoke about. He looks human, but this cannot be -- he would be about five thousand years old!
entries.target: 这似乎就是笔记中提到的“实验体 Z”。他看起来像人类，但这不可能——他应该有大约五千岁了！

entries.source: A beautifully soft robe of fine white fur. It looks designed for a halfling noble, with glorious sapphires sewn across the hems. But entrancing as it is, you can't help but feel a little queasy wearing it.
entries.target: 一件由上等白色毛皮制成的长袍，柔软而美丽。它看起来是为半身人贵族设计的，衣边缀满了华美的蓝宝石。尽管它是如此迷人，穿上它时你却忍不住有些恶心。

entries.source: This strange globe of blue light seems to be alive and asleep. Nothing about it moves, yet you can feel the crushing power of its dreams assaulting your mind.
entries.target: 这个奇怪的蓝色光球似乎是活的，而且正在熟睡。它纹丝不动，你却能感受到它梦境中那股压倒性的力量正冲击着你的精神。

entries.source: An invocation portal, perpetually summoning beings through it.
entries.target: 一个召唤传送门，不断地从中召唤出生物。

entries.source: A creature stands before you, with long tentacle-like appendages and a squat bump in place of a head. An intense aura of power radiates from this being unlike anything you've ever felt before. It can only be a Sher'Tul. A living Sher'Tul!
entries.target: 一个生物站在你面前，它有着长长的、类似触须的附肢，头部的位置只有一个矮墩墩的突起。一股强烈的力量从它身上散发出来，与你以往感受过的任何力量都截然不同。它只可能是夏·图尔人。一名活生生的夏·图尔人！

entries.source: snowy grass
entries.target: 落雪的草地

entries.source: The rift leads to another floor of the dungeon.
entries.target: 这道裂隙通往地城的另一层。

entries.source: phial filled with metallic liquid
entries.target: 装满金属般液体的小瓶

entries.source: phial filled with slimy liquid
entries.target: 装满黏糊糊液体的小瓶

entries.source: sandy
entries.target: 沙质

entries.source: unhewn
entries.target: 未开凿的

entries.source: We will end this!
entries.target: 我们会了结这一切！

entries.source: and fed to his corrupted dogs
entries.target: 并将其喂给了他腐化的战犬

entries.source: A shadow traces across the floor.
entries.target: 一道阴影从地板上掠过。

entries.source: way to the old forest
entries.target: 通往古老森林的路

entries.source: As you descend to the next level you traverse a kind of magical barrier keeping the water away. The barrier seems to be failing however and the next level is flooded too.
entries.target: 当你下到下一层时，你穿过了一道阻挡湖水的魔法屏障。然而这道屏障似乎正在失效，下一层同样被水淹没了。

entries.source: bloody heart
entries.target: 血淋淋的心脏

entries.source: In rich families the dead are sometimes put to rest with some treasures. However they also sometime protect the coffins with powerful curses. Open?
entries.target: 富裕人家有时会以财宝为死者陪葬。然而他们有时也会用强大的诅咒来守护棺材。要打开吗？

entries.source: Crack in the floor
entries.target: 地面上的裂缝

entries.source:
This area appears to have been hit by a huge tremor, breaking the floor in a huge crack.
You think you can jump to the level below.
entries.target:
这块区域似乎经历过一场剧烈的震动，地面裂开了一道巨大的裂缝。
你觉得你可以跳到下一层去。
